verdict.rationale: monday.com documents event-driven execution: workflows run in real time when data changes, agents fire when messaged, assigned or mentioned, and integrations sync both ways to trigger automations. It also says users can "set the rules" for agents. However, the evidence never describes a user-facing rule builder (when-X-then-Y conditions and actions), and much of the event support appears on the developer platform side. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a no-code event→condition→action rule builder, catalog of available triggers/actions for end users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
Fire when an agent is messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned in an update.
Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.
Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
